card.name: Words just before a price amount
card.fires_on: Small words like only, about, for, just, lowest or a that come right before a price is stated, as in "for only $25". Mostly seen in sales and subscription text.

modes.label: Qualifier before a dollar amount
modes.description: Words such as only, about or just placed right before a price figure.
modes.example: You can purchase a single-day subscription for<< only>> $0.75 to read this

modes.label: For before a price
modes.description: The word for after an item or offer, leading into what it costs.

modes.label: Cost phrasing without a number
modes.description: Words like lowest or a in phrases that lead into cost or price.
modes.example: all at<< a>> competitive, predetermined price.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with price or cost words such as priced, prices and costs.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before a price is given, like the "only" in "for only $25".
